COMPANY OVERVIEW
Salt is a North American marketing agency that creates connected experiences through creative, digital & media innovation.
Our mission is to “Earn the World’s Attention” and Salt is built to find, develop, execute, and amplify the ideas that are worthy of our clients’ audiences. We’ve structured our agency to do what’s right for our clients – to connect different perspectives, to work across mediums, and to focus on delivering meaningful, effective results.
We’re committed to living up to the values in our name. “Salt of The Earth” means we value collaborative, humble, hard-working people here. We’re looking for people who are as smart as they are kind because we believe the right talent and the right culture help us do what’s right for our clients.
ROLE OVERVIEW
As a Creative Director at Salt, you’ll lead the vision, craft, and culture of creativity across one of our most exciting tier-one clients—where sport, music, and culture intersect. You’ll shape the creative direction for fully integrated campaigns that connect ideas, experiences, and audiences in bold new ways.
This role is built for a creative leader who understands what makes great ideas great; how to invent them, evaluate them, and bring them to life across any medium. You balance imagination with discipline, guiding teams to push boundaries while ensuring ideas deliver against strategy, brand, and business goals.
A Creative Director at Salt knows that powerful ideas take many forms. They might start as a story, an experience, a piece of content, or something entirely unexpected, but always connect people and brands in meaningful ways. You’ll model creative curiosity, collaboration, and integrity, empowering your team to explore, experiment, and elevate every brief that comes through the door.
CORE RESPONSIBILITIES
Creative Ideation & Development
Lead the creation of breakthrough ideas that align with client strategy, brand purpose, and audience insight.
Translate big, abstract thinking into clear, powerful, and actionable concepts across mediums.
Cultivate a culture of curiosity and experimentation, encouraging diverse perspectives and creative bravery.
Partner with Strategy and Account teams to ensure ideas are grounded in business objectives and audience understanding.
Creative Execution
Oversee the development of campaign deliverables across digital, social, experiential, and traditional channels.
Ensure creative work maintains excellence from concept through production, protecting both quality and intent.
Review, refine, and approve work at key milestones—balancing boldness with feasibility.
Collaborate closely with Production and Project Management to deliver work efficiently, on time, and on budget.
Creative Direction
Provide hands-on direction and mentorship to Art Directors, Copywriters, Designers, and ACDs.
Lead by example - showing, not just telling, how strong ideas and craft come to life.
Foster an environment where feedback is constructive, collaboration is encouraged, and creative standards are clear.
Ensure the creative department’s voice is represented across cross-functional discussions and decision-making.
Presentation & Client Partnership
Act as a lead storyteller and presenter, confidently articulating creative thinking in ways that inspire and influence.
Build trust and rapport with clients by demonstrating strategic understanding, creative excellence, and transparency.
Represent the agency in key client meetings, new business pitches, and industry events.
Partner with senior Account and Strategy leaders to strengthen client relationships and identify opportunities for growth.
Creative Strategy
Translate brand and business objectives into inspiring creative platforms and campaigns.
Guide the team in connecting insight to execution—ensuring every idea ladders up to a clear strategic intent.
Collaborate with Strategy, Data, and Media teams to evolve creative effectiveness and inform future direction.
Bring cultural, social, and technological awareness to the creative process to keep work relevant and resonant.
Creative Administration (Finance & Operations)
Partner with the Executive Creative Director to manage team resourcing, budget planning, and operational efficiency.
Ensure accurate forecasting and allocation of creative resources based on project needs and priorities.
Contribute to recruitment, talent planning, and succession development within the creative discipline.
Uphold Salt’s creative and ethical standards, ensuring financial responsibility and alignment with agency values.
EXPERIENCE & SKILLS
10-13 years of creative experience in an agency or brand environment, with a proven record leading integrated, multi-channel campaigns across digital, experiential, social, and traditional media.
Strong conceptual and strategic thinker with a demonstrated ability to develop big, unconventional ideas that connect insight, brand purpose, and cultural relevance.
Experienced creative leader who inspires, mentors, and develops talent across disciplines—able to set a creative vision, uphold standards, and nurture a collaborative, inclusive team culture.
Exceptional storytelling and presentation skills, with confidence translating complex thinking into simple, powerful narratives for clients and internal teams alike.
Proven track record of delivering world-class creative work from concept through execution, balancing bold creative ambition with operational and financial discipline.
Production expertise across diverse mediums, with a deep understanding of how to bring ideas to life efficiently, within scope, and with craft excellence.
Strong client partnership and influence, with the ability to build trust, manage senior stakeholders, and shape creative strategy at the executive level.
Financial and operational acumen, experienced in scoping, budgeting, and resource planning to ensure sustainable delivery and profitability across projects.
Curious, adaptable, and culturally attuned, staying ahead of emerging trends, technologies, and creative approaches to continuously elevate the work.
PERKS & BENEFITS THAT SET US APART
We don’t just talk about balance, growth, and culture, we build for it:
Work-Life Flexibility:
Hybrid setup, up to 28 paid days off, and winter holiday shutdown.
Comprehensive Coverage:
Health, dental, and vision plans, plus Salt Bucks to spend on what matters to you—wellness, RRSPs, or extra time off.
Growth-Driven Culture:
Dedicated Salt Days, top-tier learning access, and formal leadership development.
Celebration-First Mentality:
Legendary team trips, seasonal socials, and Salt Swag that reps your squad.
Real Rewards:
Referral and new business bonuses, exclusive lifestyle perks, and personalized wellness options.
Culture of Belonging:
DEI programs, active ERGs, and a workplace where every voice counts.
WHAT WE STAND FOR
Salt of the Earth:
We lead with humility, honesty, and heart—always.
Do What’s Right:
No shortcuts. We choose integrity over ease, every time.
Earn Your Salt:
We roll up our sleeves, chase results, and celebrate the journey.
Make Things Better:
We’re solution-seekers, always pushing for smarter ways forward.
Seek Different Perspectives:
Diversity fuels our thinking. Inclusion drives our impact.

About the role
Join Anthropic's Customer Success team in a high-impact role driving AI adoption across our Industry segment. As an Enterprise Customer Success Manager, GSI, you'll be the strategic partner and a trusted advisor to our most complex customers with a portfolio spanning Systems Integrators—helping them harness the full potential of all our Claude capabilities - API, Claude for Enterprise, and Claude Code.
You'll work with organizations transforming their businesses with AI technology. Developing genuine partnerships with customers, gaining a deep understanding of their business objectives, strategic direction, AI vision, and technical needs. You'll draw on both your business acumen and technical expertise to serve as a strategic advisor throughout their journey with us.
In partnership with the broader account team you will help customers identify the right Claude capabilities for their specific business objectives, working closely with them to provide best practices and guidance while supporting them as their usage (consumption & seat based) grows and evolves.
Your role focuses on helping customers scale their usage effectively, drive model and use case optimizations, implement change management strategies, and maximize the value of their investment through expanded use cases across their organization. The insights you gather from your customers will directly inform our research priorities, product development, and go-to-market strategies — making you a key voice in shaping how we build and deliver ongoing value as a business.

Build trusting, strategic relationships with key customer decision makers to understand their business and objectives, identifying opportunities for optimization and expansion
Become an expert in Anthropic's products across API, Claude Code and Claude for Enterprise, understanding the technical nuances and best practices for each to guide customers to the right solutions
Leverage your deep knowledge of the customer and their industry vertical to proactively drive usage planning, understanding current and future consumption/adoption and how it creates realized value for the customer
Monitor usage patterns and identify optimization opportunities, proactively addressing underutilization across both consumption-based (API) and seat-based (Claude for Enterprise / Claude Code) products to drive full value from contracted commitments
Serve as the customer's thought partner, enhancing their knowledge of Claude products by socializing Anthropic's product roadmap, driving awareness on new products and engaging Product PMs
Document and quantify customer value realized through business outcomes, ROI, and impact metrics to build compelling internal business cases for continued and expanded investment
Identify potential use cases and lines of business not currently onboarded, partnering with customers and Sales to discover new applications for Claude across different departments, teams, and workflows
Develop and execute change management strategies to drive end-user adoption and maximize value within customer organizations, including Train the Trainer programs, Center of Excellence development, and organizational enablement
Own the customer experience across their lifecycle — managing comprehensive account and success plans grounded in the customer's business objectives, conducting Quarterly Business Reviews, and serving as the primary conduit between the customer and Anthropic

This position is focused on quality engineering and test execution. While it is not a full-time software development role, candidates should have strong automation experience and be comfortable working with automation frameworks, reviewing automated tests, and collaborating with automation engineers to improve test coverage and CI/CD validation.

Execute end-to-end testing activities for iOS mobile applications, including functional, integration, regression, and end-to-end testing.
Review product requirements, UX flows, and technical designs to identify test scenarios and develop comprehensive test plans.
Perform manual and automated testing using iOS simulators, physical devices, and cloud testing platforms such as Sauce Labs or BrowserStack.
Collaborate with developers and SDETs to identify opportunities to increase automation coverage and improve overall test effectiveness.
Execute and validate automated test suites, investigate failures, and support troubleshooting of automation issues.
Analyze application logs, reproduce reported issues, validate bug fixes, and assist with root cause analysis.
Create clear and actionable defect reports, including reproduction steps, logs, screenshots, and supporting evidence.
Validate mobile application interactions with backend services through API and integration testing, including testing with mocked services when appropriate.
Support continuous integration and release validation by executing automated and manual test activities within CI/CD pipelines such as Jenkins and GitHub Actions.
Work closely with cross-functional teams including engineering, product management, architecture, QA, and operations in an agile development environment.
What We're Looking For
5+ years of experience in software quality engineering, with strong hands-on experience testing iOS mobile applications.
Experience creating test plans, identifying test scenarios, and executing comprehensive manual and automated testing.
Hands-on experience with mobile automation frameworks such as Appium and familiarity with Python-based automation.
Understanding of the iOS application release lifecycle, including TestFlight, build pipelines, versioning, and release validation.
Experience testing on iOS simulators, physical devices, and cloud testing platforms such as Sauce Labs or BrowserStack.
Familiarity with automation frameworks such as
Pytest
, WebdriverIO, or Playwright, with the ability to review automated tests, troubleshoot failures, and collaborate with automation engineers.
Basic programming or scripting experience (Python preferred; Java, JavaScript, or C# is a plus) sufficient to understand automation frameworks, troubleshoot failures, and contribute where appropriate.
Experience working with CI/CD pipelines such as Jenkins or GitHub Actions.
Strong analytical, debugging, and problem-solving skills.
Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with experience working across distributed teams.
Ability to quickly learn new technologies and adapt in a fast-paced development environment.
Nice to Have
Experience testing PlayStation or gaming-related applications.
Familiarity with PlayStation SDKs.
Experience with GitHub Actions.
Experience testing applications that interact with cloud services or REST APIs.
